scheme_name: Agricultural Activities for Persons with Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana.
Applicant must have a disability of at least 40%.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old, unless they have mental retardation, in which case the minimum age is 14 years.
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹10,00,000 are provided to persons with disabilities for agricultural production, irrigation, horticulture, sericulture, machinery purchase and marketing of agricultural products.
